<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Coffee Time|id=A0047}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Finally! JP and Liliana reveal the secret of Leo's coffee: a little bit of '''leche''' – milk, which is also our keyword. Moreover, we learn about Mexican coffee culture. Mmm!
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0007|A0007: Where are you from?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0023|A0023: Going to the market]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0052|A0052: Smells good]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Oye! ¿Te apetece un café?'''
| Hey! Do you want a coffee?
| '''Claro que sí.'''
| Of course yes.
| '''¿Solo o con leche?'''
| Black or with milk?
| '''Con un poco de leche, por favor.'''
| With a little bit of milk, please.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¡Oye! ¿Te apetece un café?'''
| Hey! Do you want a coffee?
| '''Claro que sí.'''
| Of course yes.
| '''¿Solo o con leche?'''
| Black or with milk?
| '''Con un poco de leche, por favor.'''
| With a little bit of milk, please.
}}</includeonly>

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Would you like a little bit of milk?
| '''¿Te apetece un poco de leche?'''
| Coffee with milk?
| '''¿Café con leche?'''
| Of course. One coffee with milk.
| '''Claro. Un café con leche.'''
| Hey!
| '''¡Oye!'''
| Yes?
| '''¿Sí?'''
| A black coffee, please.
| '''Un café solo, por favor.'''
| You would like a black coffee?
| '''¿Te apetece un café solo?'''
| Of course yes.
| '''Claro que sí.'''
| Of course.
| '''Claro.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Would you like a little bit of milk?
| '''¿Te apetece un poco de leche?'''
| Coffee with milk?
| '''¿Café con leche?'''
| Of course. One coffee with milk.
| '''Claro. Un café con leche.'''
| Hey!
| '''¡Oye!'''
| Yes?
| '''¿Sí?'''
| A black coffee, please.
| '''Un café solo, por favor.'''
| You would like a black coffee?
| '''¿Te apetece un café solo?'''
| Of course yes.
| '''Claro que sí.'''
| Of course.
| '''Claro.'''
}}</includeonly>
